title: Fixed handleProduce episode mismatch in editorial server

content.what: Modified handleProduce in editorial-dashboard-server.mjs to extract episode number from safePath and pass it as --episode to run_humanos_mvp.py.
content.why: The script was launching without --episode, causing run_humanos_mvp.py to default to EP0001 instead of EP0003 for James Dyson, failing silently.
content.learned: Python script run_humanos_mvp.py expects --episode to locate the correct directory, otherwise it defaults to 1.
